bootstrap.method: One-hour circular residual blocks; conditional on selected profile/baseline, not astrophysical false-alarm calibration.

localization.motion_assessment: Amplitude-weighted hourly linear displacement compared with blank-time stationary injections at the observed hourly amplitudes. Conditional noise diagnostic, not a blanket asteroid exclusion or orbital proper motion.
localization.interpretation: Offset relative to the observed target template, calibrated with stationary injections at blank times. Conditional on template and empirical noise, not an association posterior or resolved-component identification.

energy.temperature_geometry_scope: Same nominal L=54.640694Lsun,Tstar=5205.7764K,Tflare=9000K for every event; sensitivity envelope is not a confidence interval.

assumptions.extinction: No additional extinction or epoch-dependent luminosity correction; systematic uncertainty retained.

sensitivity.profiles: Measured finite-cadence asymmetric profiles;48 uniform peak times per interval, including gaps. Native OR20min screen; observed noise held fixed, running baseline recomputed.
sensitivity.qualification: Effective search time is model-specific, finite-grid exploratory recovery exposure after FFI calibration. It is not a universal completeness correction or a population flare-frequency distribution.
